name: @af-utils/virtual-core
description: Model for rendering large scrollable data

scripts.build: tsc && pnpm esbuild:build && pnpm api-extractor && pnpm test:artifacts
scripts.esbuild:format: biome format --config-path=biome.dist.json --write dist/index.production.js dist/index.development.js dist/index.node.production.js dist/index.node.development.js
scripts.esbuild:build: rm -f dist/index.js dist/index.node.js dist/index.production.js dist/index.development.js dist/index.node.production.js dist/index.node.development.js && pnpm esbuild:base src/index.ts src/index.node.ts --outdir=dist --entry-names=[name].production && pnpm esbuild:base src/index.ts src/index.node.ts --conditions=development --outdir=dist --entry-names=[name].development && pnpm esbuild:format
scripts.esbuild:dev: rm -f dist/index.js dist/index.node.js dist/index.production.js dist/index.development.js dist/index.node.production.js dist/index.node.development.js && pnpm esbuild:base src/index.ts src/index.node.ts --conditions=development --outdir=dist --entry-names=[name].development --watch
scripts.jit:build: esbuild src/models/SizeIndex/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=.jit/SizeIndex.mjs && esbuild src/models/VirtualScroller/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=.jit/VirtualScroller.mjs && esbuild src/models/VirtualScrollerLayout/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=.jit/VirtualScrollerLayout.mjs && esbuild src/benchmarks/privateFieldFixture.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=.jit/PrivateFieldFixture.mjs
scripts.jit:check: pnpm jit:build && node --allow-natives-syntax scripts/check-representations.mjs && node --allow-natives-syntax --trace-deopt scripts/check-monomorphism.mjs && node --allow-natives-syntax --trace-deopt scripts/check-private-fields.mjs
